recipe.visualDefinition: A 1970s-style album cover featuring a hand-drawn illustration of four men's faces arranged horizontally, emerging from a red jigsaw puzzle base against a solid black background. The entire image is overlaid with a subtle jigsaw puzzle piece outline texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale display type dominates the top third of the composition.
Illustrated portraits are anchored to a jagged, puzzle-piece bottom border.
High contrast between the deep black background and vibrant red graphic elements.
Textured puzzle lines unify the foreground illustration and background space.
coreInvariants: Jigsaw puzzle piece outlines across the entire surface.
Red puzzle-edge border at the bottom.
Three-dimensional effect on the primary display text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four portraits occupy the lower half, scaled to fill the width. Large title text spans the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red, jagged puzzle-piece border at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large red title, moves down to the central subtitle, then scans the four faces from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black void in the upper-middle section provides breathing room for the subtitle.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements vs. naturalistic, slightly desaturated tones in the pencil illustration.

letterConstructionRules: 3D extrusion effect with a metallic or reflective side profile
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are squeezed together so they physically touch or overlap.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display face paired with a clean, flat bold sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for the display text.
Good for the subtitle to maintain a 70s clean aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1970s style illustration of four men with feathered hair and retro sunglasses, arranged in a row. The bottom of the image should be a bright red jagged border shaped like interlocking jigsaw puzzle pieces. The background is solid black. Overlay a faint, thin-lined jigsaw puzzle piece pattern across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, red 3D extruded sans-serif title at the top, with letters touching. Below it, add a smaller yellow bold sans-serif subtitle in title case.

verificationChecks: Does the bottom border look like puzzle pieces?
Is the puzzle piece texture visible across the whole image?
Is the main title red with a 3D effect?
Are the portraits in a hand-drawn pencil/crayon style?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the puzzle overlay lines
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the men
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the puzzle lines are thin and do not obscure the faces.
Check that the 3D text looks integrated, not just flat.
Verify the red of the title matches the red of the bottom border.
Confirm the illustration style feels like colored pencil or pastel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject Illustration] with [Jigsaw Puzzle Overlay] + [Red Die-Cut Border] + [3D Block Typography] for a retro 70s aesthetic.
